manual_semantic_review: All three languages distinguish required model rent from negotiated market rent.
Nominal historical periods, coarse dates, new versus aged aircraft, appraiser bases, chart digitization and published ranges remain explicit.
Range midpoint is a scenario convention, not a published transaction mean.
Debt cash flows are separate from the unlevered asset valuation; residual debt is repaid at sale.
Accounting residual and depreciation differ from ten-year resale; initial costs are capitalized.
Gross rent/price, asset IRR, equity IRR, accounting profit and equity cash flow are correctly distinguished.
IFRS 16 recognition is described with exceptions; deposits and maintenance reserves are not automatically profit, and reimbursed maintenance is not double counted.
Lufthansa transaction counts and tenors agree with its primary report; no per-aircraft transaction price is inferred.
